verdict.rationale: SumUp's documented architectures keep card capture on its side. With the Cloud API, the POS only sends HTTPS requests and the Solo reader completes the transaction. Hosted Checkout runs on a SumUp-hosted payment page, and offline mode caches card data securely on the device. None of this evidence mentions PCI, certified hardware, or reduced scope. Missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS scope-reduction claims, reader certification (e.g. PCI PTS / P2PE) evidence, vendor guidance on merchant's remaining PCI obligations (SAQ type, attestation), independent corroboration.
